name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
steps: Lie on your side beside a sturdy chair braced against a wall and rest your upper ankle on the seat.
Set your lower elbow beneath your shoulder and press the supported leg into the seat to lift your hips.
Draw the lower leg up toward the underside of the seat while keeping your pelvis level.
Lower the bottom leg under control, then lower your hips and switch sides.
tips: Keep your shoulders and hips stacked as the lower leg moves.
Press your forearm into the floor throughout the lift.
